name: taom_equipmentsets
description: Standalone EquipmentRoster sets (equipmentsets/taom_equipment_sets_*.xml). Equipment ids (Item.*) and the culture attribute (Culture.*) are checked by the global sweep. The civilian_equipment_type special rule enforces .claude/rules/xml-data.md: any roster whose id contains '_civ' must tag its <EquipmentSet> with equipmentType="Civilian" or the engine misclassifies it as battle gear (Faramir/Boromir wrong-outfit bug).
